elements.name: Real Frame Allocator initializes and performs sanity checks

steps.name: the serial output should contain "Initializing Real Frame Allocator..."
the serial output should contain "frame_alloc: base="
the serial output should contain "frame_alloc: total="
the serial output should contain "Running frame_alloc sanity check..."
the serial output should contain "frame_alloc: sanity ok"
the serial output should contain "System halted"
